parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: ListType
parameters.description:
The type of the list. Valid values:

- **1**: user-defined

- **2**: address book

parameters.name: ListValue
parameters.description: The value that corresponds to the list type.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member account.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

parameters.name: WhiteType
parameters.description:
The type of the whitelist. Valid values:

- **1**: destination

- **2**: source
